set_text.text: The default of 50 cases a pallet will not fit every line. Bulky lines such as paper goods pallet far fewer, so weight the average by what sits on your racks.
Throughput that never sits on a rack
Weeks of cover divides capacity by every case you move. Leave out product that arrives and leaves the same day, or cover looks shorter than it is.
Where VOS fits, and where it stops
The cases you move start as orders

VOS does not measure your building or run your warehouse. It sits on the order side: customers order by voice in the VOS app, and each order arrives with a number, date and timestamp. Those dated app orders give one check on the monthly cases you enter.
Each account's order history in the admin platform
Catalog updates as stock levels change
Runs alongside your stock system, not instead of it
Fewer stockout surprises and last-minute substitutions
